Punchbowl News reports that Thom Tillis, the North Carolina senator who is retiring after refusing to support Trump’s signature domestic policy bill last year, noted that Pulte played a major role in accusing Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook of mortgage fraud, an investigation the senator opposed.
